title.narrative: Strengthening Women Journalists Safety Against TFGBV in Pakistan

description.narrative: This initiative aims to strengthen the safety and protection ecosystem for women journalists in Pakistan by addressing the growing risks of Technology-Facilitated Gender-Based Violence (TFGBV) in the digital space. Building existing evidence and national stakeholder consultations, the programme focuses on enhancing institutional capacities, improving coordination mechanisms, and increasing awareness of available protection and reporting pathways. The initiative will support a comprehensive approach that includes a baseline report of the TFGBV protection ecosystem, and (based on the report) develop targeted training resource for law enforcement and relevant authorities on digital harms and international standards on freedom of expression. Through these interventions, the programme seeks to bridge critical gaps between victims, journalists, and institutions responsible for prevention and response, while fostering a more enabling, responsive, and gender-sensitive digital environment for journalism in Pakistan.
